name: Factor Mining & Research Agents
description: Hypothesis generation, search allocation and evolutionary research workflows.
description_zh: 从假设生成、搜索分配到因子谱系，比较自动化研究流程。

name: Return Prediction & Supervision
description: Simple baselines, label horizons, relational models and latent factors.
description_zh: 从简单基线、标签期限到关系和潜在因子建模。

name: Online Learning & Adaptation
description: Concept drift, incremental updates and market regime changes.
description_zh: 研究模型如何应对数据分布漂移和市场状态变化。

name: Portfolio Management & RL
description: Representations and predictions translated into portfolio decisions.
description_zh: 把预测或市场表示转化为仓位和动态组合决策。

name: Risk, Covariance & Filtering
description: Volatility, covariance, tail scenarios and latent-state estimation.
name_zh: 风险、协方差与状态估计
description_zh: 研究波动、协方差、尾部场景与隐藏状态。

name: Momentum & Asset Pricing
description: End-to-end momentum, test portfolios and international return prediction.
description_zh: 连接端到端策略、测试组合构造与跨市场预测。

name: Microstructure & Execution
description: Order books, lead-lag relationships, volume and execution costs.
description_zh: 从盘口信号、领先滞后关系到成交量和执行成本。
